summary: 1. Borrower data carry the signal: Model B PR-AUC 0.2211 vs no-skill 0.1489; ROC-AUC 0.6387.
2. Adding macro (Model C) changes PR-AUC by -0.0004, ROC-AUC by -0.0005, Brier by +0.00025; CV folds agree in size (+0.0006 PR-AUC).
3. Non-linear trees do not change this: Model D - Model D-base PR-AUC = -0.0004. Macro alone: ROC-AUC 0.497.
4. Calibration: actual 2015 rate 14.89%; Model B predicts 13.78%, Model C 13.09%. Correlation of the macro shift with B's monthly miss: -0.73.
5. Lender pricing adds what we lack: lender benchmark PR-AUC 0.2621.
6. Embargoed training (outcomes known by 2015): B 0.1975, C 0.1973 PR-AUC.
